name: Busa Product Hub
description: Product & certification hub for export/trade sellers: catalog/SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, a certificate expiry tracker, and an approval-gated review queue (channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle decisions, and unsourced spec claims). The AirApp itself only ever decides on a review item (approve/request_changes/block) directly onto its own record -- it never creates a product, channel, inventory, or certificate row.
